Chapter 1362 - 29: Devouring The Chaos Void

Chapter 1362: Chapter 29: Devouring the Chaos Void

Turning his head towards the deepest part of the Chaos Void.

The other six time lifeforms did the same.

The newly ascended Shisan Rank Luo Hou also looked towards the deepest part of the Chaos Void.

That area used to be the time cycle zone, and since the Chaos Void was opened up, all lifeforms attempting to reach the Shisan Rank have fallen into that region.

Not long ago, Lin Yuan began his breakthrough, forming the largest time cycle zone ever recorded deep in the Chaos Void, an expanse larger than all previous zones.

And now.

The eight Shisan Rank time lifeforms clearly felt the time cycle zone in the deepest part of the Chaos Void vibrating.

The vibration was so intense that even the Great Saints of the Chaos Void became aware of it and looked towards the source of the tremor.

"It’s the time cycle zone of the Galaxy."

Lord Mo Xu immediately concluded; such vast and exaggerated quaking could almost only be attributed to Lin Yuan, as there were hardly any other possibilities.

It’s worth noting that when Luo Hou successfully broke through the time cycle, the tremor it caused was comparable to a tiny ripple compared to the current monumental waves.

"Is it that the Galaxy Great Saint is about to cross into the Shisan Rank as well?"

Luo Hou marveled inwardly; he had long known from Lord Mo Xu and other seven time lifeforms about Lin Yuan’s inevitable entry into the Shisan Rank.

He just hadn’t expected it to happen this fast.

How long has it been since Lin Yuan started choosing to break through to the Shisan Rank?

Not even two hundred years.

"Let’s go."

"Let’s wait for the Galaxy to come out."

Lord Mo Xu glanced at the other seven time lifeforms and immediately headed towards the deepest part of the Chaos Void.

...

Returning his consciousness to his body, Lin Yuan’s life essence immediately began to transform towards the Shisan Rank.

The strand of consciousness that had passed the test already evolved to the Shisan Rank at the moment the time cycle world began to collapse.

Returning to his body now, like a drop of ink into clear water, Lin Yuan’s life essence rapidly transformed, rising at a terrifying pace.

The elevation of life essence made Lin Yuan’s perspective suddenly become exceptionally broad.

Standing high enables one to see far.

Why can time lifeforms observe future timelines?

It’s their life essence itself, observing timelines is instinctual for the Shisan Rank, like fish born to swim.

And at this moment.

Lin Yuan also possessed this instinct.

He no longer relied on the Rune Dao, nor on the lord’s position.

He could effortlessly observe the future timelines.

Compared to someone like Luo Hou, a newly ascended time lifeform,

Lin Yuan was already proficient in observing timelines.

Thus, there wasn’t the need for familiarity.

"Is this the timeline with a normal view?"

Lin Yuan, observing the timeline through his life essence for the first time, felt unprecedented ease.

"In combination with the Rune Dao?"

Runes subtly emerged in Lin Yuan’s eyes.

In an instant, the number and depth of timelines he observed increased significantly.

In a split second, he had viewed several thousand future timelines a million years ahead.

"Endless timelines, fundamentally impossible to see them all."

Upon reaching the Shisan Rank, Lin Yuan sensed a certain sense of smallness.

Like life on a planet first touching the vast starry sky.

Countless timelines intertwined, every time node spawning countless timelines, limitless and boundless.

Even powerful time lifeforms could only change future timelines in a small area, and must contend with other time lifeforms; compared to the infinite timelines, what does the slight change made by time lifeforms represent?

"Lord’s position?"

Lin Yuan stopped observing future timelines.

Instead, he began to feel something existing within him.

The lord position of the Lord of Heaven Light.

Before stepping into the Shisan Rank, Lin Yuan had little perception of the lord position.

Could only use it passively.

But now, with his life essence transformed.

Lin Yuan clearly sensed the presence of the lord position.

"The lord position is condensed from a Tao Fruit of a Time Lord, not every fallen Time Lord can form a lord position." Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The lord position of the Lord of Heaven Light, strictly speaking, was not condensed out, but rather dispersed into the bodies of all beings in the second Source World.

It was Lin Yuan who relied on the uniqueness of the Martial Arts Evolution Road, spending tens of thousands of years to re-condense it.

Other powerhouses, even the Eternal Lords, have no way to condense the shattered lord position from the depths of billions of beings’ bloodlines.

If they could, the Eternal Lords in the second Source World would have laid some groundwork for it.

"Based on my comprehension of the Rune Dao, as long as I am willing, I can refine this lord position in a short time and become a Time Lord."

Lin Yuan felt the aura of the lord position within him, coming to this conclusion.

And through observing timelines of actively refining this lord position, he knew the time it would take to completely refine it.

Fifty thousand years.

It would only take fifty thousand years for him to inherit everything about this lord position.

Become the new Time Lord.

"But..."

Lin Yuan gently shook his head.

If he really did so, Lin Yuan would completely abandon the current Chaotic Taiji Dao, turning to follow the path of the Lord of Heaven Light.

The path the Lord of Heaven Light took to become a Time Lord is certainly perfect, but the Chaotic Taiji Dao is a path created by Lin Yuan himself, born of his own effort.

Naturally, it is impossible to give up.

And the Lord of Heaven Light failed to become a Perfect Time Being when impacting the Fourteenth Rank, proving that his path cannot reach the Fourteenth Rank level.

Lin Yuan certainly would not abandon the Chaotic Taiji Dao to walk a dead-end road.

"Even without refining the lord position, the ability to drive and use it to observe future timelines aids me more than most Second Realm time lifeforms."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

When he was at the Twelfth Rank, the lord position made observing future timelines much easier, and now his life essence reaches the Shisan Rank, coaxing greater power from the lord position.

"Are Lord Mo Xu and the others waiting for me?"

Lin Yuan slightly opened up his perception and sensed the presence of the eight time lifeforms.

"Let’s quickly complete the final breakthrough."

Lin Yuan looked towards the Chaos Void.

Breaking through the time cycle merely signifies his life essence reaching the Shisan Rank.

As for aspects like his physical body, spirit, and soul, they still remain at the Twelfth Rank level.

More accurately, it’s between the Twelfth Rank and Shisan Rank level, though Lin Yuan’s physical strength had long reached the threshold of the Shisan Rank, this large realm crossover still allows for great enhancement.

"And also..."

Lin Yuan looked towards the suppressive Chaos Void.

This dimensional space in the Chaos Void grants an Origin Source infusion to every life that comprehends the Rule of Time and undergoes a major breakthrough.

The amount of Origin Source capacity depends entirely on oneself.

Rumble—Lin Yuan felt the entire Chaos Void vibrating as it began actively absorbing the energy aura from the dimensional gaps around it.

The next moment.

Endless Chaos Void Origin Source poured down frantically towards Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan’s internal universe rapidly evolved, and the endless Constant Sand Particle World quickly transformed, continuously absorbing and devouring the infused Chaos Void Origin Source.

"What is this?"

Originally waiting for Lin Yuan to emerge, Lord Mo Xu and the eight time lifeforms were somewhat dumbfounded watching the entire Chaos Void Origin Source being boundlessly consumed by Lin Yuan.
